CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

3. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

4. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

5. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weaving and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
